# Flowmoat

> Flowmoat is an AI engineering and automation company that builds AI-powered software,
> modernizes existing systems, and automates business workflows for businesses of every
> size — from solo founders and small teams to established organizations — across the
> United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and the United Arab Emirates.

Flowmoat combines product thinking with engineering discipline. Engagements start with the
business outcome, then work backward to the right architecture. Flowmoat also builds and
operates its own SaaS products, which means its team has firsthand experience turning complex
business domains into production software rather than delivering isolated features.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://flowmoat.com/services/): The four capabilities Flowmoat delivers and how to choose between them.
- [AI Engineering](https://flowmoat.com/services/ai-engineering/): Production AI systems — AI agents, copilots, permission-aware retrieval (RAG), and document intelligence, with evaluation harnesses and human oversight built in.
- [AI Modernization](https://flowmoat.com/services/ai-modernization/): Adding AI to existing CRMs, ERPs, portals, SaaS products, and legacy systems through their data and APIs, without a migration or a rebuild.
- [Custom Software Development](https://flowmoat.com/services/custom-software-development/): Custom SaaS, internal platforms, business portals, dashboards, and back-office systems, delivered end to end.
- [Workflow Automation](https://flowmoat.com/services/workflow-automation/): Business process automation, API integration, and custom workflow engineering using n8n, Make, and custom Python where platforms cannot reach.

## Products

- [RegRely](https://regrely.com): AI-powered compliance and privacy management platform for compliance programs, privacy operations, vendor risk, and governance.
- [GreenOH](https://thegreenoh.com): Pakistan's first solar aggregator platform, where homes and businesses compare verified solar installers through one trusted marketplace.

## Company

- [About Flowmoat](https://flowmoat.com/about/): How Flowmoat works, its engineering principles, and the markets it serves.
- [Our work](https://flowmoat.com/work/): The products Flowmoat has built and operates. Client case studies are published only with the client's written permission.

## Who Flowmoat works with

Business owners, solo founders, CEOs, CTOs, COOs, VP Engineering, VP Operations, and IT Directors
at companies of every size — from a five-person team to a few thousand people. Engagements are
scoped and priced individually rather than from a published price list.

## How engagements work

1. **Discover** — Map the objective, current workflow, users, systems, data, constraints, and success criteria.
2. **Architect** — Define the product experience, technical approach, integration boundaries, controls, and phased delivery plan.
3. **Build** — Deliver working software in focused iterations, with regular demonstrations and transparent decisions.
4. **Scale** — Support rollout, measure performance, strengthen the system, and evolve it as the business grows.
